notes: Refined existing stories to cleanly map to schema/contract, core logic, API, integration, and testing per ARCH-001 without creating duplicates.

change_log.value: Define canonical service contracts using Pydantic models and explicit interfaces for all layers (facade, application, domain). Include request/response schemas, validation rules, and anti-corruption boundaries to prevent cross-layer leakage.

Refactor domain and shared services into isolated modules aligned to ARCH-001 (9 services), enforcing strict layer boundaries, eliminating implicit dependencies, and centralizing business logic within domain services.
change_log.note: Aligned to core logic and ARCH-001 service count

change_log.value: Implement facade-driven API access by updating application facades and tool_router to enforce contract-only invocation, ensuring all external interactions route through facades with validated schemas.
Establish integration composition root in main.py with explicit dependency injection, service wiring, and lifecycle management consistent with modular monolith design.
Implement comprehensive unit, integration, and regression tests validating contract enforcement, service isolation, and parity with pre-refactor E2E outputs.
